const st = window.__ensemble; const chatId = st.getState().chatId; const N = 25; const busy = (a) => a.phase !== 'idle' && a.phase !== 'error'; const liveSig = (s) => Object.values(s.agents).filter(busy).map(a => a.chatId + ':' + a.accountId + ':' + (a.phase === 'waiting' ? 1 : 0)).join('|'); const summary = (s) => { const on = Object.values(s.agents).filter(busy); return on.length + '|' + new Set(on.map(a => a.chatId)).size }; const chatAgents = (s) => Object.values(s.agents).filter(a => a.chatId === chatId); window.__measure = async (noBatch, ms) => { window.__ensembleNoBatch = noBatch; window.__renders = { composer: 0 }; let notes = 0, whole = 0, narrowLive = 0, narrowSum = 0, narrowChat = 0; let lastLive = liveSig(st.getState()), lastSum = summary(st.getState()), lastChat = chatAgents(st.getState()); const unsub = st.subscribe((s, prev) => { notes++; if (s.agents !== prev.agents) whole++; const l = liveSig(s); if (l !== lastLive) { narrowLive++; lastLive = l } const m = summary(s); if (m !== lastSum) { narrowSum++; lastSum = m } const c = chatAgents(s); if (c.length !== lastChat.length || c.some((x, i) => x !== lastChat[i])) { narrowChat++; lastChat = c } }); let tick = 0, events = 0; const t0 = performance.now(); const iv = setInterval(() => { tick++; for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { if ((tick + i) % 3 === 0) { st.getState().receive({ type: 'agent', state: { chatId, accountId: 'fake-' + i, phase: 'tool', activity: 'Step ' + tick + ' of agent ' + i, queued: 0, turnStartedAt: 1000 + i } }); events++ } if ((tick + i) % 2 === 0) { st.getState().receive({ type: 'item-delta', chatId, accountId: 'fake-' + i, id: 'fake-item-' + i, text: 'word ' }); events++ } } }, 40); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); clearInterval(iv); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); const sec = (performance.now() - t0) / 1000; unsub(); for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) st.getState().receive({ type: 'agent', state: { chatId, accountId: 'fake-' + i, phase: 'idle', queued: 0 } }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const f = (n) => (n / sec).toFixed(1); return { events: f(events), notes: f(notes), whole: f(whole), chatList: f(narrowLive), nowButton: f(narrowSum), chatTabs: f(narrowChat), composer: f(window.__renders.composer) } }; const before = await window.__measure(true, 4000); const after = await window.__measure(false, 4000); window.__ensembleNoBatch = false; return 'PER SECOND, 25 fake agents. BEFORE (no batching): ' + JSON.stringify(before) + ' || AFTER (batched): ' + JSON.stringify(after) + ' || whole = re-renders of each part that selects the whole agents map (Sidebar ChatList, NowButton, TeamDock, ChatView tabs and strip: 5 of them); chatList/nowButton = parts that switch to useLiveByChat/useWorkSummary; chatTabs = parts that switch to useChatAgents (the fake agents are in this chat, so they change on every batch)'
